description_en: Recovers a Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance that has been terminated
description_zh: 调用RecoverVirtualBorderRouter接口恢复被终止的VBR实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc recover-virtual-border-router --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id vbr-bp1lhl0taikrte0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecoverVirtualBorderRouter

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
